description: This source file defines the class 'Option' within the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Catalog'. The class provides methods for managing product options in the OpenCart system, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving options, their descriptions, values, and related data in the database.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: A class in the OpenCart system for managing product options, including creation, modification, deletion, and retrieval of options and their related descriptions, values, and multilingual data.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Inserts a new option into the database, adds its descriptions for multiple languages, and handles associated option values.

methods.name: editOption
methods.description: Updates an existing option's data, manages its descriptions and values, including deletion and re-insertion.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Deletes an option and its associated descriptions and values from the database.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific option, including its description.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of options based on filter and sorting criteria.

methods.name: getTotalOptions
methods.description: Returns the total number of options in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an option in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific option.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions for options in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific option.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for options in a specific language.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a value for an option, including its description in multiple languages.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific option value.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves all values associated with a specific option.

methods.name: addValueDescription
methods.description: Adds a multilingual description for an option value.

methods.name: deleteValueDescriptionsByOptionId
methods.description: Deletes all value descriptions for a specific option.

methods.name: deleteValues
methods.description: Deletes all values associated with a specific option.

methods.name: getValueDescriptions
methods.description: Get Value Descriptions for a specific option ID, including descriptions in all supported languages.

methods.name: getValueDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Get Value Descriptions filtered by a specific language ID.
